value_shape.keys: an SSO login, exactly as the owner ladder names it (case-sensitive, no trimming)
value_shape.whole_map: a map that is not an object, or carries a key that is not a non-empty string or a value outside `values`, is unreadable as a whole

sources.producer: the build render (phase 4); nothing at runtime writes this key
sources.value_from: tier_writes(section) of the resolved render for that login

sources.login: a login the roster does not name
sources.tier: absent: the stated owner_unknown refusal (a role-carry key may be added later without breaking the shape)

rung_applies_when: a control-context tree is bound (OSPREY_CONTROL_CONTEXT_TREE set, usable or not)

terms.skip: the rung does not apply: no map in the section and no tree bound
terms.allowed: the owner is mapped to allowed
terms.never: the owner is mapped to never
terms.unknown: the rung applies and the owner's tier cannot be read

refusal_arms.when: tree bound and the section carries no map
the map is not an object
the map carries a non-string key, a non-string value or a string value other than allowed/never
no owner, or an owner that is not a non-empty string
the owner is missing from the map
the owner is mapped to never
